description: Controlled semantic reviewer evaluation. Synthetic cases are not factual news or publications. evaluate_review.py expand() rebuilds each full case.

sources.title: dirauth: Remove bastet from list
passages: Last night, bastet's operator notified us that the machine is very plausibly compromised.
In any kind of scenario here, the keys can't be trusted anymore and bastet will generate a new identity soon.
In the meantime, remove bastet from source as we can't trust it anymore.
